claim: In fiscal 2026 Q2, Microsoft reported R&D expense of $8.5B and revenue of $91.6B.
summary: Microsoft fiscal 2026 Q2 covers Oct-Dec 2025, reported after knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04. Both the claimed $91.6B revenue and $8.5B R&D expense cannot be verified from pre-cutoff knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft reported revenue of $91.6B for fiscal 2026 Q2.
sub_claims.note: Fiscal 2026 Q2 ended Dec 31, 2025 and was reported late Jan 2026, after knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04; this specific quarterly revenue figure is not established by prior knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft reported R&D expense of $8.5B for fiscal 2026 Q2.
sub_claims.note: Fiscal 2026 Q2 ended Dec 31, 2025 and was reported late Jan 2026, after knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04; this specific quarterly R&D expense figure is not established by prior knowledge.
